name: Climb and Slide
desc:
Climb and Slide 🎉

Climb up tall ladders and rocket down massive slides. Rack up rewards as you go. Start in places like the Beach, then unlock fresh worlds to keep the runs feeling new.

Climb, slide, repeat. Go for the win. 👑

How to Play:
🪜 Climb the ladder and reach the top
🛝 Slide down fast
💰 Collect coins to upgrade your run
🌍 Unlock new maps and ladders
🏆 Chase leaderboards

👍 Join our group and follow for updates!
